notes.content:
WHAT

Creates a parent planner row for the current show and planning week.

WHY

Parent rows anchor all downstream child content generation and ensure idempotency via week_key.

USED IN

Phase 1 — Weekly Planner V2

Step 1.2 — Build

INPUTS

- current_show_id

- week_key

OUTPUTS

- New parent row in BW_CONTENT_QUEUE

VALIDATION

- Row is created only when Parent Not Found filter passes

- row_type = parent

- source_type = shows

WHAT

Searches BW_CONTENT_QUEUE for an existing parent row for the current show in the current planning week.

WHY

Weekly Planner must be idempotent and must not create duplicate parent rows.

USED IN

Phase 1 — Weekly Planner V2

Step 1.2 — Build

INPUTS

- current_show_id

- week_key

OUTPUTS

- 0+ matching parent rows (bundles)

VALIDATION

- Returns 0 bundles when no parent exists

- Returns 1+ bundles when a parent already exists for the same show_id + week_key

WHAT

Computes the Weekly Planner deduplication key (week_key) for the current show.

WHY

Weekly Planner must be idempotent. week_key prevents creating duplicate parent rows for the same show in the same planning week.

USED IN

Phase 1 — Weekly Planner V2

Step 1.2 — Build

INPUTS

- current_show_id

- now (current time)

OUTPUTS

- week_key (string) in format: v2|shows|<source_id>|<YYYY-Www>

VALIDATION

- week_key matches pattern and includes current_show_id

WHAT

Extracts the event date for the current iterated show.

WHY

Used for planning windows, week alignment, and date-based eligibility logic.

USED IN

Phase 1 — Weekly Planner V2

Step 1.2 — Build

INPUTS

- Read Shows Source → event_date (B)

OUTPUTS

- Variable: current_show_date (date)

VALIDATION

- Value equals the show event_date (e.g., 2026-02-28)

WHAT

Extracts the stable show identifier (row_id) for the current iterated show.

WHY

Provides a canonical key used for joins, logging, and downstream planner fan-out logic.

USED IN

Phase 1 — Weekly Planner V2

Step 1.2 — Build

INPUTS

- Read Shows Source → row_id (A)

OUTPUTS

- Variable: current_show_id (string)

VALIDATION

- Value equals the show row_id (e.g., SHOW-EXAMPLE-001)

WHAT

Stores the current iterated show row as a named variable.

WHY

Provides a stable per-show context for downstream planner logic without remapping fields repeatedly.

USED IN

Phase 1 — Weekly Planner V2

Step 1.2 — Build

INPUTS

- Bundle from Iterate Active Shows

OUTPUTS

- Variable: current_show (full show row object)

VALIDATION

- Variable is populated once per active show iteration

WHAT

Iterates once per active show returned from the Shows source.

WHY

Establishes a per-show execution context for the Weekly Planner fan-out.

USED IN

Phase 1 — Weekly Planner V2

Step 1.2 — Build

INPUTS

- Array: Read Shows Source → Search Rows [bundle]

OUTPUTS

- Single show row per bundle (flattened)

VALIDATION

- Emits exactly one bundle per active show row

WHEN: Phase 1 → Step 1.2 → Micro-step 1.2.3-G

WHAT: Reads BW_SOURCES_SHOWS rows.

WHY: Weekly Planner uses show dates to generate planned content within the boost window.

USED IN: BW_V2__WeeklyPlanner after planner_settings is built.

INPUTS: BW_AI_Social_Agent_V2 / BW_SOURCES_SHOWS.

OUTPUTS: Show row bundles (row_id, event_date, venue, city/state, status, notes).

FAILURE MODES: Sheet missing; headers missing; empty sheet; connection error.

VALIDATION: Returns at least the example row SHOW-EXAMPLE-001 (or your real rows).

WHEN: Phase 1 → Step 1.2 → Micro-step 1.2.3-E

WHAT: Initializes an empty planner settings key/value map.

WHY: Provides a mutable object to populate during iteration of planner settings.

USED IN: BW_V2__WeeklyPlanner, before Iterate Planner Settings.

INPUTS: None.

OUTPUTS: planner_settings_map initialized as empty object {}.

FAILURE MODES: Variable mis-typed as string or array instead of object.

VALIDATION: planner_settings_map exists and is empty before iteration.

WHEN: Phase 1 → Step 1.2 → Micro-step 1.2.3-C

WHAT: Aggregates BW_PLANNER_SETTINGS rows into a single array.

WHY: Prevents downstream modules from iterating individual planner rows repeatedly.

USED IN: BW_V2__WeeklyPlanner scenario, after Read Planner Settings.

INPUTS: key, value, notes rows from BW_PLANNER_SETTINGS.

OUTPUTS: One bundle containing an array of planner settings.

FAILURE MODES: Source sheet empty; fields not mapped correctly.

VALIDATION: Output is a single bundle with array entries including default_posts_per_week.

WHEN: Phase 1 → Step 1.2 → Micro-step 1.2.3-B

WHAT: Reads planner configuration rows.

WHY: Weekly Planner requires cadence and approval rules before planning.

USED IN: BW_V2__WeeklyPlanner.

OUTPUTS: key/value planner settings.

VALIDATION: Rows returned.

WHEN: Phase 1 → Step 1.2 → Micro-step 1.2.3-A

WHAT: Initializes run-scoped variables for the Weekly Planner execution.

WHY: Provides a clear run context identifier before any reads, writes, or logging occur.

USED IN: BW_V2__WeeklyPlanner scenario (first module).

INPUTS: Manual scenario run.

OUTPUTS: run_source=weekly_planner_v2

FAILURE MODES: None expected (local variable assignment only).

VALIDATION: Module renamed correctly, variable present, notes added.
